set.body:
Scope: NeuroVolume/NeuroSeries and related neuroimage admission/IO; neuroim4s core and optional IO.

Deliverable: Extend the minimal repository from U2 with neuroimaging volume/series refinements and meaningful scientific policy. Move IO admission around image4s parsing/encoding, without copying generic image or NIfTI machinery.

Acceptance:
- Independent volume/series consumers compile/test on JVM/JS with no surface/atlas/MVPA/ScalaFIM dependency.
- Values retain exact image4s/Ravel representation and owner; continuous/categorical/mask roles, time-axis admission, affine/scaling, views and canonical order survive.
- Provider NIfTI support remains unchanged; bounded reads and allocation checks pass; tests/fixtures and narrow validated public constructors move with the implementation.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: I1: Move neuroimaging values and IO policy over native image4s
